author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Anthropic should release a meta skill that distills any webpage into a CLI based navigation skill.
It will be a long time before all websites support web-mcp.
If AI can't see it, it doesn't exist.  There is so much information that is easy for humans to consume but it is very hard to feed it to AI.
Plus, you can strip all the ads in CLI.
